- "confirm" could mean **Deck App** **Press** or **VitaDeck Shell** confirmation; resolved: **Shell Face Input** uses Cross/Circle conventions in the Shell, while **Deck Apps** use **Press**.

- "Enter" could mean **Deck App** activation or **Shell Face Input** confirm; resolved: **Host Shell Confirm Mapping** applies only while the **VitaDeck Shell** is open; in a **Deck App** Enter is Cross and presses the **Button** with **Focus**.

- "Enter" could mean **Deck App** activation or **Shell Face Input** confirm; resolved: **Host Shell Confirm Mapping** applies only while the **VitaDeck Shell** is open; in a **Deck App** Enter is Cross and presses the control with **Focus**, except during a **Text Input** edit, where it confirms the edit.
- "focus" could mean the Shell's highlighted row or the **Deck App** control Cross presses; resolved: **Focus** is the **Deck App** term, and the Shell keeps **Shell Face Input** language.
- "Backspace" could mean Shell back or a **Deck App** input; resolved: it is Circle, so back while the **VitaDeck Shell** is open and the `circle` **Pad Button** while a **Deck App** runs.

- "Backspace" could mean Shell back or a **Deck App** input; resolved: it is Circle, so back while the **VitaDeck Shell** is open and the `circle` **Pad Button** while a **Deck App** runs; during a **Text Input** edit it deletes a character.
- "Surface" and "viewport" were considered for the root display component; resolved: the public component is **Screen**.
- "render function" suggests author-controlled bootstrapping; resolved: authors export a **Deck App Component** and VitaDeck bootstraps it.
- "entry" can mean author source or generated package code; resolved: **Deck App Source Entry** is authored, **Deck App Package Entry** is generated.
## Focus and pad buttons
One `Button` at a time has focus: the D-pad moves it and Cross presses it. Touch presses a `Button` directly.
One `Button` or `TextInput` at a time has focus: the D-pad moves it and Cross presses it. Touch presses it directly.
```tsx
import { Button, usePadButton } from "@vitadeck/sdk";
- `usePadButton(button, { onPressStart, onPressEnd })` listens to `"circle"`, `"triangle"`, `"square"`, `"l"` or `"r"` while the component is mounted. Start and Select belong to VitaDeck.

- On the desktop build, arrow keys and Enter are the D-pad and Cross; Backspace, T, S, L and R are Circle, Triangle, Square, L and R; hovering a `Button` with the mouse focuses it. The full table is under [Host mappings](https://github.com/matemolnar8/vitadeck/blob/main/CONTEXT.md#host-mappings).
## Text input

`TextInput` is a controlled single-line field. Pressing it starts an edit: the Vita opens its keyboard dialog, pre-filled with `value` and titled with `placeholder`; the desktop build edits in place, where you type, Backspace deletes, Enter confirms and Escape cancels. `onChange` fires once with the final text when the edit is confirmed; a cancelled edit fires nothing.
```tsx
import { TextInput } from "@vitadeck/sdk";
const [name, setName] = useState("");
<TextInput x={20} y={80} width={400} height={56} value={name} onChange={setName} placeholder="Your name" />;

`maxLength` (default 256, at most 2048) counts like `string.length`. It takes focus like a `Button`, with `focusColor` as its outline (default: `textColor`). Text is UTF-8; characters outside the runtime font render as boxes.
## Links
- **Repository:** [https://github.com/matemolnar8/vitadeck](https://github.com/matemolnar8/vitadeck) (monorepo; this package is under `js/packages/sdk`.)

+## Text input
+
+`TextInput` is a controlled single-line field. Pressing it starts an edit: the Vita opens its keyboard dialog, pre-filled with `value` and titled with `placeholder`; the desktop build edits in place, where you type, Backspace deletes, Enter confirms and Escape cancels. `onChange` fires once with the final text when the edit is confirmed; a cancelled edit fires nothing.
+
+```tsx
+import { TextInput } from "@vitadeck/sdk";
+
+const [name, setName] = useState("");
+
+<TextInput x={20} y={80} width={400} height={56} value={name} onChange={setName} placeholder="Your name" />;
+```
+
+`maxLength` (default 256, at most 2048) counts like `string.length`. It takes focus like a `Button`, with `focusColor` as its outline (default: `textColor`). Text is UTF-8; characters outside the runtime font render as boxes.
+

## Text input

`TextInput` is a controlled single-line field. Pressing it starts an edit: the Vita opens its keyboard dialog, pre-filled with `value` and titled with `placeholder`; the desktop build edits in place, where you type, Backspace deletes, Enter confirms and Escape cancels. `onChange` fires once with the final text when the edit is confirmed; a cancelled edit fires nothing.
```tsx
import { TextInput } from "@vitadeck/sdk";
const [name, setName] = useState("");
<TextInput x={20} y={80} width={400} height={56} value={name} onChange={setName} placeholder="Your name" />;

`maxLength` (default 256, at most 2048) counts like `string.length`. It takes focus like a `Button`, with `focusColor` as its outline (default: `textColor`). Text is UTF-8; characters outside the runtime font render as boxes.
